points: Prediction covers agentic AI built through vendor forward-deployed engineering (FDE)
Under 20% of FDE work will become core vendor product features through 2028
Gartner warns of 'FDE washing': consulting relabelled at premium prices
take: Vendor forward-deployed engineering builds agents fast but leaves lock-in and cost. Write knowledge transfer, IP and exit terms into contracts before signing.
title: Gartner: 70% will abandon vendor-built agentic AI by 2028
